title: T-11 (2026-11-13): a joining player's OWN real estate runs its daily pass - RealEstateHelper.RunDaily is no longer skipped whole on clients; the client's building is paid its daily rent (booked rent revenue == DailyIncome), while the market sub-steps (UpdateBuildingsForSale, SimulateCompetitorBuyingAIBuildings) stay host-only - the client creates no listing
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1; Murray Hill special rival ju1yVbREcE2B5ymg6q5tyA== owns for-rent buildings). Dev build with the myrealestate lever (TestDrive.cs) and rivalrent buy (client, no money). NOTHING is saved (fixture reset): the bought building is not kept.

steps.note: the client is served its save and settles
a free building to give the client (the existing DEV buy lever takes any registration)
Client1 owns the building on its own machine (occupancy 50, market rent price) and the host records the deed

steps.expect_result: ^OK myrealestate day=\d+ money=\S+ n=1 income=[1-9][0-9]*\.[0-9]{2} paid=0\.00
steps.note: PREMISE: the building has tenants (DailyIncome > 0) and no rent was booked for it yet (bought today)
REPORT: the host's own buildings (the client's building must NOT be listed here)

TEST (F1/F2 2026-11-13, deterministic): on the host the client's building is not the host's own (plain=False), but with the market scope opened the way UpdateBuildingsForSale / SimulateCompetitorBuyingAIBuildings open it the ownership test answers True because the deed ledger gives it to Client1 - so neither market step can list it or sell it AI-to-AI
the lever (and the scope) are host-only; a client gets the refusal
live time crosses midnight on both machines: NewDay -> RealEstateHelper.RunDaily (now NOT skipped on the client)

steps.expect_result: ^OK myrealestate day=\d+ money=\S+ n=1 income=[1-9][0-9]*\.[0-9]{2} paid=[1-9][0-9]*\.[0-9]{2} paidmatch=True
steps.note: TEST: the client booked the building's rent for the day just ended, equal to its DailyIncome (UpdatePlayerRealEstate -> ChangeMoneySafe adds it to the money); the day number is past ${day0}; the money went up by that amount on top of the other midnight changes (was ${money0})
REPORT: occupancy may have moved (the daily occupancy roll ran on the client)
REPORT: the host still does not hold the client's building

TEST (F1/F2 2026-11-13): after the host's midnight market steps the client's building is NOT on the host's for-sale market and the deed still names Client1; owned=False also shows the host's ownership test is unchanged outside those two steps. Weak alone: the host's daily listing pick is random - the deterministic check is the 'marketowned' step before midnight (see the '[RealEstate] host market step' report line for whether the guard was consulted)
TEST: the client still owns its building and nothing listed it on its machine (no unasked AI sale)
